templates.name: event-page
templates.description: Rich event landing page: hero with video and event meta, sticky sub-nav, welcome band, product-category grids (modality section), whats-new video carousel, resources cards, and news list.

templates.name: event-stub
templates.description: Minimal event page: post-content container with an event title heading and (often empty) content area. Used for webinars/redirect events with little on-page content.

templates.name: news-article
templates.description: News/press-release stub page: post-content container with the release title as a heading and a content area (full article body lives on the corporate newsroom).

templates.name: product-page
templates.description: [NOT IMPORTED] Product detail fragments. Each product URL begins with an unconditional <script>window.location.href = '/'</script>, so it self-redirects to the homepage under any JS-enabled importer. These are popup fragments loaded within event pages, not standalone pages. Excluded from this migration run. Infrastructure (parsers/transformers/import-product-page.js) is retained should a no-JS capture path become available.
